practical: Demonstration of portable liquid penetrant inspection technique; Safety precautions regarding chemical handling and PPE usage; Instructor supervision of trainee application steps
intro_questions: What are the three main types of NDT methods?
Why is surface preparation critical before penetrant inspection?
Which NDT method is best for detecting subsurface cracks?

development.content:
Physical principles of liquid penetrant
Limitations of penetrant inspection
Description of penetrant process steps

Penetrant system liquid penetrant materials

Technique using portable equipment

Interpretation of penetrant indications
Cleaning and post-inspection procedures
Quality control checks

summary_questions: Explain the capillary action principle in penetrant inspection.
List two major limitations of the liquid penetrant method.
Describe the correct sequence for removing excess penetrant.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report comparing the advantages and limitations of liquid penetrant inspection versus magnetic particle inspection for non-ferrous materials.
